notes: Synthetic: authored by hand, 2026-10-28; ai.google.dev and cloud.google.com were blocked, so field names and enums come from the machine-readable references named per case in case.json notes. Values (ids, signatures, token counts, vectors, audio, text) are invented. Naming: see vertex@gemini-3.8-flash. Vertex AI embeddings through the canonical /v1/embeddings path, and (genai_embed*, added 2026-10-28) through the native embedContent passthrough, relayed untouched.

allowed_unknown_fields.reason: known gap V3: Vertex AI's truncated flag is dropped, so a client cannot tell that its input was cut to the model's limit before it was embedded (the vector then represents only the start of the text)

known gap G23: the embedding usage the API reports (usageMetadata.promptTokenCount, what embeddings are priced in) is dropped; the canonical usage is hard-coded 0, so embeddings through /v1/embeddings are never billed
